newsitem.title: ITALY: Illegal immigrants picked up off Italy.
newsitem.headline: Illegal immigrants picked up off Italy.

text.p: Italian police on Wednesday said they had picked up 40 would-be illegal immigrants found drifting at sea after an eight-day voyage during which four other people had apparently died and been thrown overboard.
The group of North Africans was intercepted by a finance police patrol boat 10 miles south of the island of Lampedusa shortly before midnight on Tuesday.

Police said they had been trying to reach the island after setting out from a port in Tunisia in a motorboat. Four immigrants had died of cold during the voyage and been thrown overboard, police quoted survivors as saying.
The crew of the motorboat was arrested. The illegal immigrants, who were suffering from the effects of cold and hunger, were taken to Lampedusa for medical checks.
The island, midway between the North African coast and Sicily, is a favoured "back door" entry point to Italy.
Illegal immigrants who are caught are moved to Sicily by the authorities and served with expulsion orders but most of them then head north to mainland Italy and other European countries, police say.
